name: quoxchat
tagline: AI chat widgets for any website
description: Deploy AI-powered chat assistants on your websites. Train on your knowledge, style to your brand, connect to your systems. BYOK — bring your own LLM key. Unlimited widgets, unlimited conversations.
shortDescription: Website chat widgets. BYOK, unlimited, fully customisable.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Deploy in minutes — one script tag on any website
Train on your docs, PDFs, URLs — answers with source citations
5 levels of CSS control — from colour picker to headless SDK
BYOK — use Claude, GPT, Gemini, or your own models
White-label — your brand, no Quox branding, ever
$199/year flat — no per-message fees, no conversation limits

widgetRoom.name: Widget Room
widgetRoom.description: 7-tab management environment per assistant: Knowledge, Training, Style, Actions, Logs, Analytics, Settings.

knowledgePipeline.name: Knowledge Pipeline
knowledgePipeline.description: Upload PDFs, crawl URLs, add Q&A pairs. Tiered RAG with FAQ cache, page context, and semantic search.

cssControl.name: 5-Level CSS Control
cssControl.description: Theme presets, CSS variables, ::part() selectors, full stylesheet override, or headless SDK.

whiteLabel.name: White-Label
whiteLabel.description: Your brand on your website. No 'Powered by' badge. No Quox branding. On all tiers.

budgetManagement.name: Budget Management
budgetManagement.description: Set monthly LLM budget limits. Auto-downgrade, hide widget, or show custom message when budget is hit.

auditTrail.name: Full Audit Trail
auditTrail.description: Every message traced with AEE correlation IDs. Conversation logs, AEE envelope drill-down. On all tiers.

humanHandoff.name: Human Handoff
humanHandoff.description: When the AI can't help, seamless escalation to your team with full conversation context.

headlessSdk.name: Headless SDK
headlessSdk.description: NPM package — build your own UI, we handle RAG, LLM routing, and audit trails.

toolConnectors.name: Tool & Connectors
toolConnectors.description: Connect to databases, REST APIs, webhooks, and QuoxFlow workflows. Your widget can take actions, not just answer.

smartRouting.name: Smart LLM Routing
smartRouting.description: Route simple queries to cheap models, complex to flagship. 70%+ LLM cost reduction with no quality drop.

simulationArena.name: Simulation Arena
simulationArena.description: Test against 49 adversarial scenarios. Security score gates production deployment. A/B prompt testing.

proactiveEngagement.name: Proactive Engagement
proactiveEngagement.description: Widget initiates conversation based on visitor behaviour — time on page, scroll depth, exit intent.

voiceWidget.name: Voice Input/Output
voiceWidget.description: Visitors can speak to the widget and hear responses. ElevenLabs or browser TTS.

standard.name: Standard
standard.includes: Everything you need to run great chat widgets

professional.name: Professional
professional.includes: Standard plus power features for scale and automation
